description: Safecall hooks. On session start, say the real date and time of this computer and where we stopped last time. Before writing to a file that already exists, make the copy that makes the change undoable - a new file is never blocked, reading is never blocked, and the only refusal is a file that could not be copied at all. Every hook checks that python3 exists first and does nothing at all if it does not: a person on Windows without python must still get a working session, not an error about a safety plugin.
